## Frosty Handshake and a Late Equalizer: McInnes' Hostile Return to Tynecastle Ends in 2-2 Draw

Derek McInnes walked into Tynecastle expecting a warm welcome, but he found a coach determined to keep the peace. The Rangers manager returned to his former club on Saturday evening to a frosty reception, culminating in a tetchy post-match handshake with Wouter Vrancken that typified the chaotic atmosphere of a gripping 2-2 draw in a Scottish Premiership fixture widely described as a box-office drama.

By half-time, both managers were already in the referee's book. When the final whistle blew, the exchange between McInnes and Vrancken was notably frosty. Vrancken, left somewhat red-faced, was unsure how to interpret the awkward moment, passing the blame to his counterpart. "You have to ask him," he told BBC Scotland.

Despite the tension, the match itself was a captivating encounter. McInnes' depleted side took the lead through Kevin Kelsy, but Hearts fought back strongly, looking set to secure all three points until Olwethu Makhanya pulled one back with a late header. For McInnes, the late winner was a bittersweet victory for parity. "We scored a brilliant goal but didn't do that enough," he admitted. "I don't think any team really grabbed the game and controlled the game, but I think Hearts had more opportunities to play in our half."

The context of McInnes' return adds a layer of complexity. Having taken Hearts to within minutes of the title before his summer exit, the 55-year-old now faces the fans he left behind. He acknowledged his "guilt" over the departure but embraced the hostile reception, stating: "It was exactly what I thought it would be. It's football, it's Scottish football." Still, he hopes "history can be kind" regarding his relationship with the Gorgie faithful.

For Vrancken, the evening highlighted the emotional toll of managing in a high-stakes league. Disappointed by the decision to award Rangers the free-kick that led to the equalizer, he nonetheless praised his side's resilience. "This team keeps believing... We have extra games, one day less recovery, all those things matter," Vrancken said. "When you see them battle and fight for each other, that's the pleasure I have as a coach."

Looking ahead, both managers face immediate challenges. McInnes must address the defensive frailties exposed in a "very topsy-turvy game," while Vrancken faces the uncertainty of makeshift full-back Rogers Mato's first-half injury, which could potentially add to a long list of absentees ahead of upcoming League Cup semi-finals. The result leaves both sides deeply unsatisfied heading into their respective semi-finals. For Rangers, the loss of three points risks slipping further down the table, while Hearts' late equalizer prevents an even more hostile home loss. Both squads will need to regroup quickly to navigate the remainder of the season.

## मैच का परिणाम और मुख्य घटनाएँ

हृदयों (हार्ट्स) और रांगर्स (Rangers) के बीच स्कॉटलैंड प्रीमियरशिप में आज एक तनावपूर्ण 2-2 की ड्रॉ का परिणाम प्रस्तुत हुआ। मैच के दौरान दोना मैनेजर्स, वौडर व्रांकन (हृदयों) और डेरी मैकिन्स (रांगर्स), के बीच एक संयमी हाथामिलाह ने कई दर्शकों को आकर्षित कर दिया। व्रांकन ने पहले हाफ के दौरान फ़ील्डर के साथ तनाव को जताया, जबकि मैकिन्स का वापसी का समय इस मचा-मचा मैच में उजागर हुआ।

## मैकिन्स की हृदयों पर अपनत्व वाला विरोध

मैकिन्स ने कहा, "मुझे लगा कि वह मेरे साथ एक मज़ेदार स्क्वाड के साथ आया है।" यह जवाब उनके संयमी व्यवहार के बाद दिया गया था। 55 साल के मैकिन्स ने अपनी हृदयों की त्योहारी भेदी के समय को स्वीकार कर लिया, कहते हुए कि "यह फुटबॉल है, यह स्कॉट्स फुटबॉल है।" उन्होंने अपनी छिपी हुई बाधा के बारे में भी गुजरे समय की याद दिलाई।

## मैच के मूल्य और रणनीतिक प्रभाव

हृदयों ने पहले हाफ में एक खराब गोल के साथ 1-0 की आगे की स्थिति बनाई, लेकिन रांगर्स ने दूसरे हाफ में दो गोल दर्ज करके मैच को बराबदी तक ले जाया। मैकिन्स ने कहा, "हमें एक शानदार गोल मिला, लेकिन हमें इतना नहीं करना चाहिए।"

## अनिश्चितताएँ और प्रायोगिक प्रभाव

व्रांकन ने मैकिन्स के संयमी व्यवहार के कारण के बारे में पूछताछ की, जबकि उन्होंने एक चौकुश हाफबैक रॉजर्स माटो के चोट के बारे में भी संदेह व्यक्त किया। यह मैच रांगर्स के लीग कप सामने आने वाले अबर्डीन (Aberdeen) के खिलाफ की तैयारी को प्रभावित कर सकता है।
